subject: [enc4k] 4K fits the 86 MiB vcodec pool (no kernel claim change); probe 8399e176 with auto level + --then ladder; 3 stagings ready
body:
Host only, nothing run on the phone.
(1) DMA per session, measured with fakevenc/run_session(.sh|_hevc.sh) --size on the real vendor set (fake hw pool = RW_CLAIM_VCODEC 0xda800000+0x5600000, page-rounded like the kernel). Guest peak (vendor ION + VCU pages) / + probe in+out (vcodecd OPEN_OK sizes) / pool spare:
 H.264 320x240 0.50M/1.68M/84.3M; 640x480 1.57M/3.07M/82.9M (phone vc14 vcodecd.log: 1.57M too, same buffer list); 1280x720 4.54M/7.25M/78.8M; 1920x1080 9.92M/15.94M/70.1M; 3840x2160 39.29M/63.08M/22.9M; 4096x2160 41.87M/67.25M/18.8M.
 HEVC 320x240 3.46M/4.63M; 640x480 4.42M/5.92M; 720p 7.05M/9.76M; 1080p 11.86M/17.88M/68.1M; 3840x2160 38.08M/61.88M/24.1M; 4096x2160 40.39M/65.76M/20.2M.
 Every session frees everything at DEINIT (end=0), so chained sessions do not accumulate. => opus-kern2 / opus-relaycrash: NO change to RW_CLAIM_VCODEC_BYTES needed for 4K (worst 67.3 of 86 MiB).
(2) Vendor writes the requested level verbatim: vc14 SPS level_idc=10 and the host 4K SPS also level_idc=10 (V4L2 default level 0). New probe sends level_idc from size*fps (H.264 31/40/42/51/52, HEVC 93/120/123/150/153). Suggestion for hw-ip (vcodecd.c, not edited by me): when OPEN.level==0 pick the level the same way, VideoToolbox/AVFoundation clients will send 0. At 4K the library touched only VENC core 0 registers on the host (no VENC_C1 window access, GCE waits on core 0) for both codecs [V-host, one IDR]. Host check FAILs for H.264 >=720p and HEVC 4K are runner artefacts (1 MiB runner bitstream buffer < fake I_PCM frame: overflow=1), M-f reached at every size.
(3) gpu/hwcodec/ios/n2vcd_probe.c (owner opus-ios, edited by opus-enc4k): pattern via new n2vcd_pattern.h (table form, identical pixels: n2vcd_pattern_gen --selftest 260/260); --level/--profile/--open-timeout(60)/--frame-timeout(10)/--console-every(10); --bitrate default 0 = vcodecd w*h*4; hex capped 1 KiB; per-frame gen_ms/wr_ms + a stats line; --then 'codec:WxH:frames:fps,...' re-execs for further sessions in one boot; files probe-PID-INDEX-CODEC-WxH.h26x. Host e2e vs test vcodecd: 64x48 + 1080p->HEVC 4K->4096x2160 chain PASS. vcodec_check.py: new 'stats' (per-frame sizes, key interval, PSNR vs the regenerated pattern), run by fetch: vc14 = PSNR_Y 47.9 dB frame 0, min/avg 33.7/39.3 at 300 kb/s.
(4) stage-vcodec.sh --preset 720p30|1080p30|1080p60|4k30|4kdci|hevc1080p30|hevc4k30|ladder. Staged (vcodecd c5e750bb + selftest bbb15a4d + plug-in ae914887 = the vc2-encode set, only the probe new 8399e176): payload-vcodec-4k (ladder), payload-vcodec-4k30, payload-vcodec-hevc1080. payload-vcodec untouched. Rehearsal on fake root: REHEARSAL_OK.
